_doc: Product footage (large, not committed: lives in footage/). Swap clips by pointing these paths
at new files and re-rendering; durations, sizes and frame rates are measured from the files.
looks: one recording of the SAME piece of work per look, all the same length, in showcase
order. The film switches between them mid-playback, so their timelines must line up.
hero: the short clip played inside the studio window in shot 2 (the product in use). Its
aspect ratio must match the hero surface (product.json studio.page).
replay.useFrom / useTo: the stretch of the look clips (seconds) the film plays through.
replay.skip: optional [from, to] seconds to jump over.
